name: screenlasso
description: Edit, mark up and convert images, work with colors and QR codes, and convert videos with the ScreenLasso app on your Mac: social media sizes, WebP and AVIF, arrows and numbered steps, HEX/OKLCH/Tailwind and WCAG contrast. Images never leave your Mac.
